variant_desc: 10-opcode stack VM, N=1M instructions dispatched (variant 3: seed=45, n_scale=2.0x)
source_citation: https://lwn.net/Articles/1010905/ — LWN 2025 'Computed gotos for efficient dispatch tables'; calibration via Rohou/Swamy/Seznec CGO 2015 (~3% on Haswell ITTAGE); CPython documents 15-20%
novelty_rationale: Tests whether the LLM knows that switch() inside a hot loop produces ONE shared indirect-jump site (BTB gets one prediction history slot) while computed-goto via labels-as-values spreads the jumps across N handler sites (one BTB slot per handler). The CFG transformation cannot be done by the compiler because it changes debugger/profiler attribution semantics. Honest calibration: target the 10-30% range, not the folklore 3x.
